text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Is that Oguri Cap?! It is! Oguri Cap has
won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (So this is Oguri's strength...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(But I know I'm getting close to
mastering the
blaze fierce and water
still. If I can keep this up...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory, Oguri
Cap! Can
you tell us how you're feeling
right now?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right now... I'm happy I beat Tama.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: How did you feel facing off against her?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Losing to her at the autumn Tenno Sho
was
rough, so I really wanted to win
today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You beat Tamamo Cross! You're the
best, Oguri
Cap!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're the leader of your whole
generation,
Oguri! We're counting on
you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
With her victory today, some are saying
that
Oguri Cap has earned her spot at
the peak of
Japan's racing scene!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
She's cemented her place as the star of
the
current classic-year generation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The star of the classic year...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(There's no questioning Oguri's
prowess.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(But I'm the one who battled for the
Classic Triple
Crown...)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is on par with Tamamo Cross
in both skill and popularity. Next year's
Twinkle Series is
shaping up to be one to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Can't say I'm surprised! Even Tamamo

acknowledged her as a rival!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're talking about this year's
classic
racers, I've got my eye on Super
Creek!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No way! Oguri's on a whole 'nother level!
I can't
wait to see how many G1s she
wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why isn't anyone saying my name?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I ran with Oguri and Tamamo today! I'm
standing
here right in front of you!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Why isn't anyone talking about our
fierce battle
at the Japanese Derby?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you beat me! The Derby is
mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No way! I won't give up! I'm winning this
for
Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhh!
Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter!
I will burn out my
very lifeforce! And that light will
serve as proof
that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine!
It's
miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Chiyono O ran like her life depended
on it!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ardan put everything on the line!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(And I tore up the track right beside
them!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(It's burned into my heart, setting it
atremble to
this very day!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
... It's not like anyone's waiting for me,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But how many people are really going to

remember my name when I'm not racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The longer I'm off the track, the more
distant a
memory I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Why should Chiyono O and Mejiro
Ardan have
to fear that they won't have
a place to return
to?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I ran with them, and I'm still here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Witness me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Oguri! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap! Good luck next year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it's going to be?! In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the center of the turf, Yaeno Muteki
throws back her head and lets out a roar
filled with
enough rage to pierce the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that angry cry is swallowed up in the 
thunderous roar of cheers for the other
two
racers. No one in the crowd hears
her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My next goal is to defeat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone is saying that she's the best!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So it stands to reason that defeating her
will
serve as proof of my power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No one will be able to ignore the person
who
brings down Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone will have to remember that Chiyono O, Ardan and I are the ones who raced in the Classic Triple Crown! We are the who will carry this generation forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki says all of this in one
rushed
breath, rage steaming off of her
as if she was truly
burning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's beginning to lose herself in her
fury.
However, the feeling driving that
rage is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An insane and forceful drive to defeat
Oguri Cap.
In other words—an obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer?! I'd like to hear what
you're
thinking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I doubt that Yaeno Muteki wants a
drawn-out
discussion right now, so I skip
straight to the
point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's found her obsession, I'll
gladly
push her towards it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Music to my ears! I couldn't have said it
better
myself!
